name: ATL Workforce Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Work a paid six-week summer job at Atlanta's airport. You learn workplace skills, get a mentor, and see careers in aviation.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors in the Atlanta area.
pay_detail: Paid. The page does not state a rate.
deadline_text: The page says applications open the first week of February through mid-March each year. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the City of Atlanta jobs website when the posting is open. You may be asked to interview, then you go to orientation. Every participant is matched with a mentor.
notes: This is the airport's own summer job program, separate from the Mayor's Summer Youth Employment Program. The 2026 City of Atlanta job posting linked from the page was no longer showing. Questions: atlworkforce@atl.com.
